## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -3.45% | 1M: -1.02%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.37% | 1M: -1.33%) RECOVERY — mixed risk signals confirm neutral regime.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit mixed: HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND & LQD (1W: +0.37% | 1M: -1.33%) RECOVERY → HYG/LQD NEUTRAL (→ flat). Fear easing: VXX (1W: -3.45% | 1M: -1.02%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Equities strong vs bonds: SPY (1W: +4.11% | 1M: +2.67%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.69%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral overall: TLT (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.69%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND (higher yields pressure duration) while broad dollar and curve readings are flat per regime data.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech leading on the week: XLK (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +1.81%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; Energy also strong: XLE (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +10.14%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Style: Growth momentum from Tech but breadth shows cyclicals participation.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US strong: SPY (1W: +4.11% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND. China/EM mixed — FXI (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +11.76%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +5.84% | 1M: -2.32%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation returning: IWM (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +5.95% | 1M: -8.19%) RECOVERY and IBIT (1W: +0.69% | 1M: +0.75%) → flat ABOVE TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Cyclicals/industrial inputs firm: CPER (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +6.08%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; precious metals mixed with GLD (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -2.09%) RECOVERY and PALL (1W: +6.94% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND while Brent/WTI show short-term pullbacks — BNO (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +13.47%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -3.91% | 1M: +10.95%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Equities breadth and XLK/SPY both timeframes positive — SPY (1W: +4.11% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +1.81%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Major divergence between equities and duration — TLT (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.69%) BELOW TREND — suppresses strong one‑way regime calls.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor exposure to areas showing strength (Tech via XLK (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +1.81%) ABOVE TREND and Energy via XLE (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to long-duration bonds (TLT (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -2.69%) BELOW TREND); monitor speculative recoveries (ARKK, IWM).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLK (if momentum holds) ABOVE TREND; XLE ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLRE (1W: -1.83% | 1M: +1.99%) CORRECTION and defensives if breadth narrows.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +6.08%) ABOVE TREND and PPLT (1W: +8.25% | 1M: +6.14%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -0.31% | 1M: -16.57%) BELOW TREND and continued corrections in oil ETFs BNO/USO.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 (complacency trigger), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLV relative ratio pivot ~2.0 (growth vs defensive pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, mixed risk signals keep the market in a neutral posture. Tech (XLK (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +1.81%) ABOVE TREND) and Energy (XLE (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND) are showing strength while the major risk is the divergence between equities and long-duration bonds — SPY ABOVE TREND vs TLT BELOW TREND, monitor closely.
